notes: Fixes the remaining Vault-open mismatch between the Hub and Quick Reference. The Secure Vault page now actively broadcasts the already-authorized 30-minute session to other open TEE tabs after unlock, so supported apps can recognize the open Vault and reveal authorized Shared/Private records without another search. No decrypted session is written to localStorage. Adaptive Checklist and encrypted Vault records are unchanged.
name: TEE v3.4.70 — Vault Session Broadcast Bridge
